Passions
Motivation: I'll find out the truth about Willow Lake.
Nature: The laws of men do not apply to me, only the rules of Nature bind me.
Allegiance: Mornien is my friend's pupil, I must see that no harm comes to her.

Background Options
3 - Elven Training (Major): You have been raised by the Elves, or have lived among them, learning the ways of the Fair Kin. Choose the Elven community that raised you. You gain the Lore of the Ages Special Trait as if you were a Silver Elf. If you already have this Special Trait, you gain 2 ranks to spend in your Kin Spell Lores as you see fit. You can also use SWI instead of BRN as a Stat modifier for your Blades Skill, provided you´re using a short sword, longsword or scimitar.
